issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents: the problem statement/UML declares a no-argument method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (it should return the total number of students). The reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) (a single boolean parameter), changing the public API. This parameter mismatch between the specification (no-arg) and the solution (boolean parameter) will confuse students about the required signature and may cause tests or graders that expect the no-argument method to fail or not compile against the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the problem statement/UML by providing a public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() method with no parameters that returns the total number of students (inscribed + guest). Update all internal call sites (for example getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()) to call the no-arg getTotalNumberOfStudents(). If optional behavior to exclude guests is desired, add a separate overloaded method (e.g., public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)) or a clearly documented helper method, but keep the specified no-argument public API to match the exercise description and tests.
